description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three different models across four evaluation benchmarks. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Benchmark," and displays four groups ordered from left to right: MathVista, MathVerse, a third category whose text label is visually obscured by a solid gray rectangle, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Score," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 35 to 80 with tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 5 units. Within each benchmark category, the chart displays a group of three adjacent bars. According to the legend in the upper right, the dark blue bars represent the SRPO-7B model, the medium blue bars represent the GRPO-7B model, and the light blue bars represent the Qwen-2.5-VL-7B model. Every bar is explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value at the top. Within every grouped cluster, the bars are consistently sorted in descending order from left to right. The tallest bar in the chart belongs to SRPO-7B in the MathVista category with a score of 75.8, followed by GRPO-7B at 72.3 and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 68.2. In the MathVerse category, the scores are 55.8, 52.9, and 46.3, respectively. The shortest bar overall is found in the obscured third category, where Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 36.9, compared to 39.9 for GRPO-7B and 42.3 for SRPO-7B. Finally, in the Physics benchmark, SRPO-7B scores 60.6, GRPO-7B scores 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 45.4. The chart background features a dashed grid aligned with the vertical axis tick marks.
